verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single mention that the all-in-one Companion App manages "FIDO2, PIV, and OTP functionality," and it is worded partly as a future plan ("will streamline"). The TOTP toolset generates codes in the browser and exports seeds for Entra ID import, which hints at OTP-related tooling but does not show OTP slots on the key itself. Missing for 10: documented TOTP/HOTP slots on the key, challenge-response support, slot configuration details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
